findings.title: Package builds fail on stale file hashes
findings.description: The changes to `finding-lint.mjs` and `findings.md` leave their approved SHA-256 values in `release-rights.json` unchanged. When the package-check workflow runs `tools/qore.py build`, its redistribution check compares those values with the changed files and raises `Redistribution review is stale` before producing a package.

findings.title: Plain-text summary hides why a review is held
findings.description: The non-JSON summary line still prints only coverage, verdict and `blocking.length`. The new `unresolved` list is never mentioned, so a `--verifier=ran` run with an unresolved high/critical PLAUSIBLE finding prints `coverage PARTIAL; verdict PENDING; 0 blocking findings.` and gives the reader no hint which ID is holding the verdict.

findings.title: Adding a profile to a generic skill now blocks the profile check
findings.description: `local_adaptations` raises `ValueError("Bundled profile baseline needs exactly one project resource")` when `references/project.json` sits next to a `release.json` that has no entry for it. A generic skill's `release.json` never lists `references/project.json`. So if a user adds a profile to a generic install, which `project-profile.md` allows ('When a profile exists, ... run the bundled checker'), the result that already passed `validate_profile` is thrown away and the checker prints `coverage: BLOCKED` and exits 2. The same code was copied into the qore-plan and qore-ux-review checkers and into `tools/context.py`.
